_status: UNVALIDATED heuristic thresholds. Detection quality is NOT measured on a labelled holdout. Confidence values are heuristic, not calibrated probabilities. Every rule is a candidate and disabled until validated: status 'validated' + validated:true + holdout {n_clips>=5, precision/recall finite in [0,1], evaluated_at ISO date, split_id, tool:'tools/evaluate.py'} measured on a labelled LOCAL holdout; a validation claim with an incomplete record -> invalid_config. Unknown rule keys -> invalid_config. Hard floors in code: min_person_sample_ratio>=0.10, zone.min_occupancy_to_analyse>=0.15; min_confidence_to_emit in [0,1]; max_events in [1,50].
_verdict_semantics: Observations are always computed and exported for local human review; they never drive the verdict. Only enabled AND validated rules (or enabled rules under the demo-only opt-in ALLOW_UNVALIDATED_RULES=1) can produce verdict=violation. With no active rule the job fails with 'no validated rule active: coverage error'. second_person_in_operator_zone can never produce a violation (hard-coded).
